name: Yoru no Teiou
source:
Azuma, a ghost writer, checks out a host club called "Yoru no Teiou". The hosts at the club was just trying to create a nice dream for him. Instead, they get mesmerized by him and wants to make Azuma theirs.....

[From Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
笔名作家东在调查一家名为“夜之帝王”的男公关俱乐部。俱乐部里的男公关本想为他编织一场美梦，却反过来被他迷住，想让东成为自己的所有物……

[来自Aarinfantasy论坛]
